headline: Council discussed warming shelter funding, an airport car rental facility, a transit director post, and remote meeting rules, with no votes recorded.
summary: The workshop covered plans for an airport car rental facility, a transit director position, a remote meeting policy, and an ethics training order. It also covered community development block grant funds for warming shelters. The transcript records no votes on these items.
discussion: Warming shelter payments: Members asked to see the contract and budget before any money is paid up front, and discussed paying per day when shelters open.
Warming shelter planning: Members discussed starting earlier next year and whether the city should apply for state funds or provide a brick-and-mortar site.
Remote meeting policy: Staff said the draft uses a version approved earlier, and members asked whether it covers ADA requirements.
Airport car rental facility: Staff said the first phase is planning and a financial analysis, expected to take six to eight months before design work starts.
Ethics training order: Staff said all council members would be invited to an interactive training if the order is approved.
